v1.name: V1 readiness
v1.status: Production rollout and intake smoke improved; designer budget/quality repairs merged, but paid website acceptance remains missing.
v1.summary: Nov 28: businessbuilder main f62af1bb9 and Stromation main 8e10dfebf5. #1271 reports AWS-checked production web :506/worker :339, Alex outage watch enabled after staging and a clean 12-minute watch; #1256/#1262/#1265 report site reader, editing, flow walk, broken-output and worker spend-checkin flips. Committed live snapshot confirms TEAM_CHAT_BRAIN and TEAM_KNOWLEDGE enabled on both processes. #1223 merged with 1,263 local tests and stub replay (good replies blocked/replaced 21/23 to 1/1; not a live held-out quality result); #1192 remains open. #1261/#1263/#1264/#1266/#1268 extend all five workers and calendar writes, but booking lane requires further flags/IAM and provider proof. #1252 reports staging signed-in intake save 201 and production read-only smoke passed; #1203 paid-start honesty merged but activation and full journey not established. #1250 reports staging audit e2e12 passed and retained before/after but improvement section omitted; latest repair not replayed. #1254/#1260 fix worker heartbeat starvation, following production rollback; #1257 merged writable /tmp and loud spend-guard failures; #1206 merged shared guard, worker flag now on, end-to-end enforcement not independently demonstrated. Stromation #384/#385 merged designer pin 5 and one per-job design budget with reserved grading tail, resume/regrade and 300 designer tests; #385 exact heavy checks passed, current CodeBuild green. Desktop-first switch is default off and not equivalent to full-site acceptance. No new accepted 8+/10 complete site after Tidy Paws failures, automatic recovery in real paid build, three handoffs, measured margins or founder-only hours. Latest businessbuilder main combined status empty; current release full gate not independently established (recent visible runs are CI infrastructure retry).

dimensions.name: Premium website delivery
dimensions.blocker: Need independent 8+/10 complete live site after pin 5/budget D, working forms and supported revisions.

dimensions.name: Complete SaaS & existing-app engineering
dimensions.blocker: Need complete deployed SaaS and existing-app handoffs.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Deliver end-to-end SaaS and existing-app change.

dimensions.name: Standard AI workforce capability
dimensions.blocker: Need five repeatedly useful live workers, provider-backed actions and held-out answer quality above 8.5/10.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Prove enabled intelligence and booking/integration outcomes with grounded evaluation.

dimensions.name: Automated custom-agent delivery
dimensions.blocker: Need creation, activation and monitoring of tailored agents.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Deploy and monitor one custom customer worker.

dimensions.name: Autonomous coordination & recovery
dimensions.blocker: Need hands-free bounded recovery and checkpoint resume verified in real delivery.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Prove automatic failure recovery and resume without founder/operator rescue.

dimensions.name: Reliability, security & ongoing maintenance
dimensions.blocker: Need current full release gate, durable deployed builder isolation, verified spend guard and restore.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Verify production/staging isolation and failure recovery on current versions.

dimensions.name: Complete customer journey & ownership
dimensions.blocker: Need real checkout, truthful paid start activation, post-fix multi-owner intake, revisions and three handoffs.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Prove purchase-to-live journeys with multiple owners.

dimensions.name: Commercial delivery & acquisition readiness
dimensions.blocker: Need complete paid audit with all promised sections and accepted website fulfillment, repeatable acquisition.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Prove paid website delivery before acquisition scale.

dimensions.name: Economic proof & low-founder-workload operation
dimensions.blocker: Need accepted-site margins, success denominator and founder-only hours.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Measure unit margins, autonomous workflow success and founder hours.

Budget D tests do not prove accepted site, margin or unattended live recovery.
A desktop-first score is not full-site acceptance; #384 keeps automatic checks and default-off switch.
Audit replay pass with omitted improvement section is not complete paid fulfillment.
No measured founder-only hours, autonomy denominator or accepted-site margins.
founderWorkloadTrend: No new measured founder-only hours or supported-workflow denominator; operator resume and newly enabled worker features are not proof of low founder workload.
nextActions: Prove the repaired designer on existing authorized staging/paid-path evidence, including full quality, functioning forms and revisions.
Verify durable builder isolation, current release safety and bounded automatic recovery.
Complete multi-owner checkout and three handoffs before broadening V3.

assumptions: The website-builder asset/recovery defect is fixed and the merged repair release is deployed and repeatedly proven within roughly 30 days.
SelfOperate receives about 150–500 qualified prospects/visitors over 90 days.
Paid conversion is roughly 1–2% while the product remains supervised.
Supervised delivery capacity remains roughly 2–4 projects per month.
Roughly half to three-quarters of eligible delivered customers retain the $299/month ongoing SelfOperate service after any included period.
businessOutlook.note: This is not a reliable demand forecast yet. One-time website/business build revenue is excluded from MRR.
